issues.description: Exercise 2.3 `GroverMultiQubitWithAuxiliaryQubit.oracle` has an inconsistent `combination` parameter type across artifacts: the problem statement describes `combination` as a bit-string (e.g., "10000"), the template annotates it as `list[int]`, while the solution implements it as `str` and iterates over characters. Students following the template type hint may implement list-based logic that will not match the expected string-based API used elsewhere (e.g., `run()` passes a string).
issues.suggestedFix: Make all artifacts consistent by changing the template `oracle` signature to `combination: str` (and update its docstring accordingly). Alternatively, if `list[int]` is intended, update the problem statement and solution to accept `list[int]` and adjust call sites (e.g., `run()` and `grover_circuit`) to pass lists.
